desc: Omnia precision riflescope is designed with features and performance tailored to the modern rifleman. Its magnification paired with an All Purpose Tactical Reticle (A.P.T.R.) illuminated MOA based reticle offers the best of both worlds for near-field CQB shooting and long distance precision fulfilling the entire range of tactical carbines. The scope also utilizes multi-coated lenses, locking and 1/4 MOA target turrets and a 30mm tube with fog-proof, water and shock resistant construction.
